title: Earthquake in an office building
text:
1. During shaking, Drop, Cover, and Hold On under a sturdy desk — away from windows and glass partitions (see during_earthquake).
2. NEVER use elevators during or after a quake. Take the stairs in single file, holding the rail; assist PWD colleagues.
3. Go to the assembly point when shaking stops or the alarm sounds. Do NOT stop for belongings — bring your phone only if instant.
4. Report for headcount and tell the marshal about anyone missing or trapped.
5. Do NOT re-enter until the building safety officer declares it safe. Expect aftershocks (see aftershock).
source: PHIVOLCS / DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards

title: Lindol sa gusali ng opisina
text:
1. Habang yumayanig, gawin ang Duck, Cover, Hold sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa — malayo sa bintana at salaming divider (tingnan ang during_earthquake).
2. HUWAG gumamit ng elevator habang o pagkatapos ng lindol. Gumamit ng hagdan nang isa-isa, kumapit sa rail; tulungan ang PWD na kasamahan.
3. Pumunta sa assembly point kapag tumigil ang pagyanig o tumunog ang alarm. HUWAG huminto para sa gamit — dalhin lang ang cellphone kung abot-kamay.
4. Mag-report sa headcount at sabihin sa marshal kung may nawawala o na-trap.
5. HUWAG bumalik hangga't hindi idinedeklarang ligtas ng safety officer. Asahan ang aftershocks (tingnan ang aftershock).
source: PHIVOLCS / DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards

title: Fire in the workplace — evacuate
text:
1. Raise the alarm and call the fire station or 911 — give the building name, floor, and exact address.
2. Leave by the stairs at once — never the elevator. Stay low under smoke and close (do not lock) doors behind you to slow the fire.
3. Use a fire extinguisher (PASS method) ONLY if trained, the fire is small, and your exit is behind you — otherwise just evacuate.
4. Go to the assembly point and report for headcount. Tell the marshal about missing persons.
5. Never re-enter. If trapped, seal door gaps with wet cloth and signal at a window (see house_fire).
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) / DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards

title: Sunog sa pinagtatrabahuhan — lumikas
text:
1. Mag-alarm at tumawag sa bombero o 911 — ibigay ang pangalan ng gusali, palapag, at eksaktong address.
2. Lumabas agad sa hagdan — huwag sa elevator. Yumuko sa ilalim ng usok at isara (huwag i-lock) ang pinto sa likuran para bumagal ang apoy.
3. Gumamit ng fire extinguisher (PASS method) KUNG sanay lang, maliit ang apoy, at nasa likuran ang labasan — kung hindi, lumikas na lang.
4. Pumunta sa assembly point at mag-report sa headcount. Sabihin sa marshal ang mga nawawala.
5. Huwag kailanman bumalik. Kung na-trap, takpan ng basang tela ang siwang ng pinto at sumenyas sa bintana (tingnan ang house_fire).
source: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) / DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards

title: Injury at a worksite (shop, factory, construction)
text:
1. Stop the machine or equipment with the emergency switch if safe — do NOT become a second victim.
2. Call for help and report to the safety officer or supervisor at once.
3. Give first aid for the injury (bleeding → firm pressure; see the matching first-aid topic). Do NOT move the person unless in danger.
4. Note the time, witnesses, and machine or substance involved — the clinic needs this for the report.
5. Go to the clinic or hospital even for 'small' injuries like eye splashes or deep cuts — chemical and tetanus risks hide.
source: DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards / Philippine Red Cross

title: Nadisgrasya sa pinagtatrabahuhan (shop, pabrika, construction)
text:
1. Patayin ang makina o kagamitan gamit ang emergency switch kung ligtas — HUWAG maging pangalawang biktima.
2. Tumawag ng tulong at iulat agad sa safety officer o supervisor.
3. Magbigay ng first aid sa sugat (pagdurugo → mariing diin; tingnan ang angkop na first-aid topic). HUWAG igalaw ang tao maliban kung nasa panganib.
4. Tandaan ang oras, mga saksi, at makinang o kemikal na sangkot — kailangan ito ng clinic sa report.
5. Magpatingin sa clinic o ospital kahit sa 'maliit' na sugat tulad ng talsik sa mata o malalim na hiwa — nagtatago ang panganib ng kemikal at tetanus.
source: DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Standards / Philippine Red Cross
